raw_response:
I’m old now, so I don’t play with too many new ideas. On my 2.6 mu, I’ll still do wheat and then maize after, same as we’ve done here for years. This land is small, so I mainly want it steady, not risky. Wheat still needs to eat well in winter and spring, and if I see the leaves turn pale, I know it wants more fertilizer. Water from the well costs money, so I won’t irrigate carelessly, but wheat in our place usually needs a few times if the sky stays dry. After wheat harvest, the maize has to go in fast. There’s no time to fuss with the field too much. I’ll use the seed I can buy easily in town, follow the usual village timing, and put fertilizer mostly around planting, then a little more when the maize gets tall. If pests are light, I won’t spray much. I spend carefully because with only 2 people in the house and such a small plot, every yuan counts, and I’d rather do what has worked before than gamble.
